description: Session-scoped triage: what did I leave open, what is rotting, and is the plan still right — answered in under a screen. Runs in seconds over the session, the working tree, open PRs, and the two ledgers (ROADMAP + RELEASES DB), then emits a ranked list capped at 7 items plus a capped strategic read. Use when the operator says "/standup", "what's open", "what did I leave hanging", "where are we", "what should I do next", or is closing out a long working session. Not for long-window defect analysis (that is /radar), not for closing one branch (/finish-line), not for cutting one task's drip (/rabbit-hole), and it never executes the work it recommends.
